[8:55PM] #Ogolonto #TrafficUpdate 

Movement in Ogolonto is mostly smooth, with some areas experiencing delays. 
The return journey from Itowolo to Ogolonto has slight delays at alternation points, while Agric area near Aunty Kenny is slow due to commercial activities. 
Ogolonto to Oba Sekunmade and Ferry terminal is clear, and Saint Margaret to Igbogbo is also moving well. 
However, areas like Ebute Police Post and Ita Elewa are experiencing slowdowns due to traffic interchange and high influx. 
Overall, traffic is manageable, with no major impediments reported with officers on ground doing the needful. 

#FollowLASTMA

[10:40PM] #OguduAlapere #TrafficUpdate 

The congestion at Ogudu inward Island route is attributed to the ongoing repair of the damaged expansion joint which has now dissipated and traffic is flowing smoothly down to Ogudu Bus Stop.
Notably, the stretch immediately after the Ogudu/Ifako Bridge, connecting Ifako down to Car Wash, is experiencing fluid movement. Conversely, the return journey from Gbagada Bridge and Olopomeji connecting Car Wash, Ifako, all the way to Otedola Bridge is proceeding without any disruptions, showcasing optimal traffic flow.

#FollowLASTMA
